# Croix-Rousse market

The Saturday morning stalls stretch along the boulevard. My regular stops: the cheese seller near the corner, the farmer with the early peaches, and the baker who keeps a loaf aside for me. Arrive before nine to avoid the crowd. Bring cash and a sturdy basket.

The best strawberries come from the stall at the far end, only in May and June. The fishmonger is open Tuesday and Friday. I often buy herbs here and chat with the producers about what is coming next week.
